lines.text: THE Garden Wrestling in agony, wrestling alone Weary for human love and finding none.
While over Olive! sleeps the moon‐light Whose is that broken prayer troubling night?
What are those drops of blood falling like rain Wrung from that heart of Thine Man of pain.
Anguish unspeakable writton Thy brow Suppliant sufferer. who art Thou?
